name: Tozik
source:
Tozik, also known as Tozikoric, is a Jut Qou Obesk who worked in the Embassy in the Call Research Initiative alongside Akizet.

He previously worked in surface sentry maintenance on Obeski before transferring to Call Research. He keeps a Corruskivi that was given to him as a gift by a former team member.

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Tozik]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
